card_text_pt: A polícia ambiental eslovaca informou em 15/05/2025 ter acusado um homem de 49 anos de Žirany por manter primatas protegidos sem prova de origem legal. A relação da polícia menciona *Leontopithecus chrysomelas*, *Saguinus midas*, dois *Callithrix geoffroyi* e um *C. penicillata*, mas não informa quantos *L. chrysomelas* havia.

card_text_en: On 15 May 2025, Slovak environmental police reported charges against a 49-year-old man in Žirany for keeping protected primates without proof of legal origin. Species listed included *Leontopithecus chrysomelas*, *Saguinus midas*, two *Callithrix geoffroyi* and one *C. penicillata*; the number of *L. chrysomelas* was not stated.
context_en:
[O1] On 15 May 2025, Slovak environmental police reported charges against a 49-year-old man in Žirany for keeping protected primates without proof of legal origin. Species listed included *Leontopithecus chrysomelas*, *Saguinus midas*, two *Callithrix geoffroyi* and one *C. penicillata*; the number of *L. chrysomelas* was not stated.

Limites da evidência / Evidence limitations: Separate investigation from Nitra, involving a different person and property. Physical confiscation and the species count were not reported; exclude from seizure totals.

card_text_es: El 15 de mayo de 2025, la policía ambiental eslovaca comunicó cargos contra un hombre de 49 años en Žirany por mantener primates protegidos sin prueba de origen legal. Se citaron *Leontopithecus chrysomelas*, *Saguinus midas*, dos *Callithrix geoffroyi* y un *C. penicillata*, sin cantidad de *L. chrysomelas*.
context_es:

Limites da evidência / Evidence limitations: Investigación distinta de la de Nitra, en otra propiedad y con otro responsable. No se informó decomiso físico ni cantidad de titíes león; excluir de totales de incautaciones.
